source: LoG1 (USA); re/log1/extract_moves.py. Facing order in all tables: down, up, left, right.

moves.name: Punch (Melee1/Melee2)
moves.hit_test: single point in front of the player must be inside the enemy hurtbox (sprite def, per facing); only the first entity (scanning the entity list from the end) is hit
moves.animation: state 3 (Melee1) or 4 (Melee2) chosen by frame_counter & 1; 16 frames (anim-tick 0x08002A52), sfx 2; cannot act until it ends
moves.effects: target: hurt state 6 -> stun 20 frames (char+0x0A) + invulnerable 80 frames (char+0x14), no knockback
moves.verified: VERIFIED: 10/10 predicted damages (verify_melee.py); hit timing observed in emulator

moves.name: Ki Blast
moves.size_rule: charge value c = 10 + ki_spent: c > 72 -> large 16x16 (pos +0), c > 20 -> medium 8x8 (pos +4,+4), else small 6x6 (pos +5,+5)
moves.ki_cost: 0 for a tap; charging drains (maxKi+15)>>4 every 8 frames while held

charge.description: While B is held and the owner is in its Ki state (5), every frame with frame_counter & 7 == 0 the projectile takes `cost` ki from the owner (only if owner ki >= cost) and adds it to its charge (+0x24). Function 0x0800B436.

moves.range_px: 3 * (10 + ki_spent) unless it hits a wall (collision layer 2) or an entity
moves.hits: first entity whose handler accepts msg 1 (0x0800283C); projectile then enters state 2 (vanish 24 anim ticks)
moves.also: destroys breakable obstacles (0x0800689A msg 1) and sends msg 6 to all entities
moves.verified: VERIFIED: damage 200 at maxHP 600 for tap and 60-frame charge (test_ki.py); flight 10 frames for a tap

moves.name: Kame Hame Ha
moves.input: B with slot 1 selected (L cycles slots, 0x08003524); must be learned (bit 1 of 0x0300004D)
moves.learned: script command 0x08006216 (class 0x08166B28) instance at 0x08543DE4: taught by King Kai after the Gregory mallet training (map 13; text 0x081612E9)

charge.description: While B is held and the owner is in its Ki state (5), every frame with frame_counter & 7 == 0 the projectile takes `cost` ki from the owner (only if owner ki >= cost) and adds it to its charge (+0x24). Function 0x0800B436.

moves.damage: ki_spent (beam charge +0x24) per hit; 0 if released without charging
moves.beam: starts 8x8 at owner pos + spawn_offset + start_offset; each frame grows 3 px along facing (grow table); stops after 16 frames (max 56 px long) or when the head enters a wall; then 8-frame retract/fly-off
moves.hits: every overlapping entity every growth frame (0x0800286A broadcast); msg flag +0x10=1 makes enemies with invulnerability timer (char+0x14) > 0 ignore it -> each enemy is damaged once per 80 frames
moves.verified: VERIFIED: damage 175 = 7 charge ticks x 25 at maxKi 400 (test_ki.py)

moves.name: Solar Flare
moves.input: B with slot 2 selected; must be learned (bit 2 of 0x0300004D)
moves.learned: script command instance at 0x08544070, just before the script warps to map 40 (Frieza area); text 0x08166468 "I shall teach you the technique of Solar Flare!"
moves.ki_cost: charge only; charge capped at maxKi

charge.description: While B is held and the owner is in its Ki state (5), every frame with frame_counter & 7 == 0 the projectile takes `cost` ki from the owner (only if owner ki >= cost) and adds it to its charge (+0x24). Function 0x0800B436.

moves.effect: freezes ALL enemy AI for duration = 60 + charge*300 // maxKi frames (60..360). Global timer 0x03003B34 checked at the top of the AI tick 0x08008018; also sets every non-flying awake enemy to idle state and reduces stun timers.
moves.cooldown: cannot fire again until frame_counter >= release_frame + duration + 60 (0x030007E4, checked in 0x08002F24)

moves.name: Flight (R)
moves.input: R toggles; requires a passable flying-layer point in front and flight energy > 0
moves.refill: pickup items 31/32/33 (+5/+10/+20, capped) via 0x080032A2; no natural regeneration
moves.landing: when energy runs out or R pressed: lands if the ground below is passable, else returns to the takeoff point
moves.verified: VERIFIED: 2 px/frame and energy 6 -> 0 in 48 frames at level 1; item 31 refilled 1 -> 6

moves.name: Enemy melee
moves.trigger: Manhattan tile distance to target <= 1 (tiles = 8 px, 0x0800F570)
moves.damage: cur_hp // 4 + rand(cur_hp // 2)  (attacker CURRENT hp; main RNG, rand(n) in [0,n]; for cur_hp//2 >= 32768 rand can go NEGATIVE -> healing bug)
moves.animation: attacker set to char state 5 (anim Melee1, 16 frames) then 45-frame cooldown (char+0x0A = 0x2D)
moves.observed_interval_frames: 69-77 for a wolf hugging the player
moves.verified: VERIFIED: wolf (350 HP) hits 105..251 observed, formula range 87..262; negative-damage bug observed (henchman 70000 HP dealt -13557)

moves.name: Enemy ki blast
moves.trigger: Manhattan distance > 1, ki > maxKi // 16, target roughly in line (attacker point within target x or y band widened by half its size), rand(100) <= 1 (2/101 per decision), not in a cutscene (0x030007DC == 0)
moves.power: rand(ki // 2) + ki // 4 ; projectile charges (spending owner ki) until charge >= power
moves.lifetime: until it leaves the camera rectangle or hits a wall/entity (0x0800BF4E)
moves.verified: VERIFIED: damage 26666 (maxHP 80000) and 5000 (maxHP 15000) observed; ~58 frames charge
